# rekabetli.com

> rekabetli.com is an online educational marketplace connecting competitive students with expert mentors for academic guidance, packages, communities, exams, and contests (YKS, olympiads, TÜBİTAK, Teknofest).

## Site

- Homepage: https://rekabetli.com/
- About: https://rekabetli.com/hakkimizda
- Who it is for: https://rekabetli.com/kimler-icin
- Mentors directory: https://rekabetli.com/mentors
- Communities: https://rekabetli.com/communities
- Exams guide: https://rekabetli.com/sinav-bilgileri
- Contests guide: https://rekabetli.com/yarisma-bilgileri
- Exams list: https://rekabetli.com/exams
- Contests list: https://rekabetli.com/competitions
- Influencer program: https://rekabetli.com/influencer-program
- Contact: https://rekabetli.com/iletisim

## Entity

- Brand: rekabetli.com
- Operator: ELT Technologies LTD (Company No. 17318502)
- Founder & CEO: İsmail Efe Eltutan
- Support: info@rekabetli.com
- Address: 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom
- Primary language: Turkish (tr)

## Product summary

Students discover mentors, purchase mentorship packages, join communities, and explore exam/competition information. Mentors publish public profile pages (vitrin) and sell packages. The platform is operated by ELT Technologies LTD.
